name: Carved Wooden Bed Headboard
description: Ornate bed headboard with deep floral and scroll carving and a heart-shaped centre medallion. A centrepiece for a master bedroom.

name: Carved Round Mirror Frame
description: Round mirror frame surrounded by dense floral carving, topped with a crown of carved roses. Suits an entrance, dresser or living room wall.

name: Carved Wooden Pooja Mandir Base
description: Tiered carved base with a lotus top and carved motif panels, made for a pooja room or prayer corner.

name: Wooden Rocking Chair with Wheel Arms
description: Rocking chair with a spindle back, carved crest and cart-wheel side panels on curved rockers.

name: Cane-Back Lounge Chair
description: Low wooden lounge chair with a woven cane back and a slatted seat. Light and airy for a verandah or reading corner.

name: Carved Peacock-Back Chair
description: Tall statement chair with a peacock-feather carved back in dark wood and padded mustard upholstery.

name: Cane-Back Carved Armchair
description: Armchair with an oval cane back, carved dark wood frame, turned legs and a cream padded seat.

name: 3-Seater Sofa with Floral Cushions
description: Three-seater sofa with patterned seat fabric, open storage arms and floral print back cushions.

name: L-Shaped Sofa in Teal and Grey
description: Corner sofa in teal and grey colour blocks with adjustable headrests and matching cushions.

name: Sculpted Console Table with Hoof Legs
description: Black console table with a wavy-edged top and sculpted legs that end in brass hoof tips. A striking piece for an entrance or hallway.

name: Wooden Writing Desk with Drawers
description: Writing desk with a raised back shelf, four drawers with brass knobs, turned legs and a brass footrail.

name: Wooden Coffee Table with Glass Top
description: Rectangular coffee table with a Greek-key style wooden frame and a clear glass top that shows off the woodwork.

name: Carved Wooden Lion Statue
description: Standing lion carved in wood with a detailed mane and muscular form. A bold decor piece for a living room or office.

name: Carved Chariot with Horses
description: Carved chariot drawn by four horses under a canopy with hanging bell tassels, mounted on a wooden base.
